label: Simulation of synthetic entered readings and composition arithmetic

brief.input: Identified post-consumer polyethylene (PCRPE) resin and an identified virgin MDPE resin. Exact grades and current proportions still need to be recorded.
brief.variation: The recycled-content proportion can change. Moisture, contamination and differences between supply lots have not been characterized.
brief.contamination: No named contaminant amount has been measured. Do not assume the recycled resin is contamination-free.
brief.product: A non-load-bearing planter sleeve — material development case
brief.use_case: An outer decorative sleeve around a separate watertight plant pot. The liner supports the soil and water. Sleeve geometry and outdoor exposure are not yet specified.
brief.targets: Material-development screen: tensile yield stress at least 25 MPa, using a stated specimen and method. This is a chosen screening threshold, not a measured planter requirement. Sleeve fit, creep and weathering targets still need to be set.
brief.process: Planning from home; no resin processing or tensile-testing equipment here. Any moulding and testing trial requires a suitable facility and a recorded process.
brief.available_changes: The recycled-to-virgin PE proportion, preparation and sleeve geometry may be considered. Keep proposed material trials separate from the finished-product checks. Do not transfer published specimen values to my resin.

details.label: Hypothetical PE material-development case

components.name: Identified virgin MDPE resin (grade to record)

details.amount_basis: Synthetic starting stock: one unprocessed portion, 250 g PCRPE and 750 g virgin MDPE. No physical mix or test.

comparison.method: Synthetic software diagnostic only. Same nominal resin grades and injection process across settings; no physical processing or tensile testing.

calculation.action: The calculated addition interval for Virgin MDPE stock (zero PCRPE) covers the entered composition range within your chosen trial target.
next_options: Use the example only as a composition trial; record the actual weighed addition.
Check mixing and the properties that matter for the product before choosing a working formulation.
assumptions: This is a user-chosen trial composition calculated from entered mass fractions, not a recipe proven to meet physical properties.
The input range is supplied by the user; it is not inferred from repeated tests, standard deviations or batch statistics.
One fixed added mass is checked against both endpoints of the specified input range for the entered portion mass.
Input and added stock use the same mass basis. Their stated fractions are assumed representative, with no losses, reactions, moisture change or incomplete mixing.
No density is used. Strength, sound performance, binder compatibility and finished-product consistency are not established.

limitations: The recorded property belongs only to the reference readings and their stated conditions.
The calculation targets one exact composition; no property interpolation or dose-response model was used.
Changing composition creates a proposed new trial. No finished-property or future-batch performance is established.
The stated addition fraction, no-loss mixing assumptions and starting composition need to hold for this calculation.
